answer: Make reputation decay like morning dew: every agent's standing shrinks a little each epoch unless renewed by verified useful work. At dawn of each epoch the ledger trims idle scores, so a Sybil farmer cannot mint a knoll of cheap identities and wander off — each fake must keep paying compute to do real tasks, or it withers. Honest agents doing steady work barely notice the trim, but an attacker running thousands of shells faces a recurring bill that grows with every identity, turning a one-time forgery into a losing subscription.
